lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，快得像风。
lines.en: Eight legs move together, quick as wind.
I walk along the cave roof, head down.

lines.zh: 我的腿多，拐弯不用减速。
lines.en: So many legs, I turn without slowing.
The crack is narrow; I turn sideways through.

lines.zh: 蛛网一颤，我就知道有东西。
lines.en: A web trembles, and I know something is there.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，一点声音没有。
lines.en: I cross the moss without a sound.
I run faster than the big spiders.

lines.zh: 脚下黏着丝，走一步拉一线。
lines.en: Silk sticks to my feet. Each step pulls a thread.
I trot in the shadow along the wall.

lines.zh: 前面的洞口有光，我停一下。
lines.en: Light at the tunnel mouth. I pause.

lines.zh: 我的影子在洞壁上乱晃。
lines.en: My shadow skitters on the cave wall.

lines.zh: 八只脚踩在碎石上，像下雨。
lines.en: Eight feet on gravel sound like rain.
I slide down along a strand of silk.

lines.zh: 别踩我的腿，断一条就跑不快。
lines.en: Do not step on my legs; lose one and I slow.
I climb back along the thread.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，只露八条腿。
lines.en: I tuck into a crack with only my legs showing.
I hang from a thread and sway.
The cave is too dry; my silk will not stick.
I groom the bristles around my mouth.
Blinking all these eyes is tiring.
I count the drops falling from the ceiling.
A maggot crawls by. I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团小球。
lines.en: I curl into a small ball.
The silk line quivers in the draft.
I wait for a corpse fly to come near.
The cave is silent except for water.
I extend one leg to test the ground.
I am hungry, but I do not move.
There is my silk above your head.
Your boots crossed into my hunting ground.
Every one of my eight eyes watches you.
You are much bigger than a corpse fly.
Your torchlight stings my eyes.
I cock my head and size you up.
Your soles carry cave mud.
You search for me. I am above you.
Do not wave your hand; my silk will snap.
You are sweating. The smell is strong.

lines.zh: 我的腿断了一条，还能跑。
lines.en: One leg is broken. I can still run.
My shell split; fluid seeps out.
You stepped on me. Lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我把八条腿收起来护住腹部。
lines.en: I fold all eight legs over my abdomen.
This much blood is not worth cheering.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，断腿掉在地上。
lines.en: I shudder, and the broken leg drops.
It hurts too much to spin straight silk.
Do not chase. I can still bite.

lines.zh: 我的眼花了，看你有八个。
lines.en: My sight blurs. I see eight of you.
Break me apart. There is a swarm behind me.
I do not eat bread. I eat insects.

lines.zh: 你捏着的那点肉，塞牙都不够。
lines.en: That scrap of meat would not fill a tooth.

lines.zh: 有尸蝇的味道，比你好闻。
lines.en: Something smells of corpse fly. Better than you.

lines.zh: 食物举那么高，我八条腿也够不着。
lines.en: Hold it that high and eight legs cannot reach.
I tilt my head, sniff, and walk away.
Carrion will do. Fresh meat too.
Do not tease me with an apple.

lines.zh: 那只蛆虫比你手里的香。
lines.en: That maggot smells better than what you hold.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我更想咬会动的。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I want something that moves.
Leave the food there and back away.
You touched my silk.
I crawl past against your leg.
You flattened one of my legs.
I am too light to hurt you.

lines.zh: 退后，我的网被你扯断了。
lines.en: Back off. You snapped my web.
I slip past the edge of your boot.
When you move, I spring away.
Do not swat me. I bite.
I land on your shoulder and leap off.
Your knee is in my way.
I am still small. Do not ask.
Ask me after this batch of eggs.
There are plenty of us. I am not needed.
There are enough webs in this cave.

lines.zh: 配对要先看网织得好不好。
lines.en: First I check whether the web is well spun.
My legs are not fully grown.
You say that to a spider?

lines.zh: 我只会产卵，不会谈恋爱。
lines.en: I only lay eggs. I do not fall in love.
The big spider is a better match.
Do not come closer. I am guarding eggs.
That insect shell is mine.
I grab it in my jaws and bolt.

lines.zh: 丝线能吊起比我还重的东西。
lines.en: Silk can lift things heavier than me.
I dragged off the arrowhead you dropped.
A piece of carrion on the ground. Mine.

lines.zh: 我用两条腿抱着战利品。
lines.en: I hug the prize with two legs.

lines.zh: 手别伸，那东西已经归我了。
lines.en: Hands off. That thing already belongs to me.
I wrap it in silk and hide it.
The item is heavy; I drag it slowly.
You bend down, and I grab it first.
Something fell into the web.
A corpse fly is buzzing over there. I go.

lines.zh: 我听见翅膀拍动的声音。
lines.en: I hear wings beating nearby.
The target is small, enough for a meal.
A thread on the ceiling moved.
The maggots are on the carrion.
Someone came in with a torch.
I hide first, then approach.
Target fixed. Soften the steps.
It is bigger than the web. Careful.

lines.zh: 我沿着丝线过去，不惊动它。
lines.en: I cross by silk without startling it.

lines.zh: 洞里所有震动，我都感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel every tremor in this cave.
It goes left. I take the ceiling route.

lines.zh: 我吊在它头顶，等它停下。
lines.en: I hang overhead and wait for it to stop.

lines.zh: 丝线一紧，它就被黏住了。
lines.en: One tug, and it is stuck fast.

lines.zh: 它转圈找我，我在它背后。
lines.en: It spins looking for me. I am behind it.
Do not chase. Let it run into the web.

lines.zh: 它还能走几步，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count the few steps it has left.

lines.zh: 它举火把照洞顶，我缩起来。
lines.en: It raises a torch. I shrink back.

lines.zh: 它在网边停住了，再近一点。
lines.en: It stopped at the web's edge. A little closer.

lines.zh: 我换个位置，让它猜不到。
lines.en: I shift position so it cannot guess.
Many legs mean fast turns.

lines.zh: 它踩断一根丝，我换一根。
lines.en: It snapped a thread. I use another.
Its only way out is that narrow crack.
One bite, and the venom goes in.
I bite the joint of its leg.
The damage is small, but it will swell.

lines.zh: 它一巴掌拍空，我跳到侧面。
lines.en: It swats and misses. I jump aside.
I bite and hold, wrapping my legs.
The venom works. It starts to sway.
My fangs are small but sink deep.

lines.zh: 它甩开我，我翻个身又上。
lines.en: It throws me off; I flip and return.
That will slow it down.
Bite and run. Do not linger.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶的卵囊里出来。
lines.en: I come out of an egg sac on the ceiling.
A cluster of little spiders, packed tight.
Deep in the cave, we wake.

lines.zh: 我的第一张网还没织好。
lines.en: My first web is not finished.
Under the stone, I crawl out.
My siblings are all around me.
We share this cave between us.

lines.zh: 别踩这块石头，我们在下面。
lines.en: Do not step on that rock. We are beneath it.
Too bright. I burrow toward the dark.

lines.zh: 丝从腹里拉出来，第一条。
lines.en: The first thread draws out of my belly.
The heat curls my silk.

lines.zh: 从洞顶掉下来，摔得发懵。
lines.en: I fell from the ceiling and landed dazed.

lines.zh: 水漫进洞里，我往高处爬。
lines.en: Water floods the cave. I climb higher.
The blast shook loose a shower of stone.
An arrow grazed my belly.

lines.zh: 魔法烧着我的腿，走不动。
lines.en: Magic burns my legs. I cannot walk.
I am hungry, but I can last a while.

lines.zh: 雷声传进洞里，我缩紧了。
lines.en: Thunder reaches into the cave. I curl tighter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有网，我抓不住。
lines.en: No web in the void. Nothing to grip.
